== Notes ==
* Very useful in [[Random Arenas]], as almost everyone is likely to have a [[Resurrection Signet]] equipped.
* The description is ambiguous. Rust will only disable a single signet on a target, and only if that target is casting a signet when struck. Additionally, Rust will disable that signet even if the target is under an effect that prevents interruption.
